channel.title: deadmanifesto — changelog
channel.description: Shipped changes to deadmanifesto, the artist archive and portfolio of Ginger Deadman.

item.title: 0.2.13 — player controls
item.description: Adds previous, next, back 10 seconds, forward 10 seconds and mute controls to the player, with clickable seek time, a clock/seconds toggle for both time numbers, tooltips and action popups.

item.title: 0.2.12 — lyric streaming placeholders
item.description: Adds streaming placeholders for YouTube Music, Spotify, YouTube, Tidal, SoundCloud, Apple Music and Amazon to every lyric page with local icons.

item.title: 0.2.11 — popup tracklist
item.description: Switches songs from the popup tracklist without changing page, links the album and up-next titles, and adds a Page button for the current track.

item.title: 0.2.10 — lyric page navigation
item.description: Adds top and bottom previous/next navigation to every lyric page and keeps the current song playing across page changes.

item.title: 0.2.9 — footer links
item.description: Adds global footer links for Contact, Disclaimer and Privacy above the no-cookies line.

item.title: 0.2.8 — Tools page
item.description: Adds a Tools page under About for language models, AI-assisted tools and traditional digital tools.

item.title: 0.2.7 — About consolidation
item.description: Combines Disclaimer, Changelog and Robots into one About page and moves Privacy under About.

item.title: 0.2.6 — album runtimes
item.description: Calculates and shows Flips, Obliviability and Obsolescence runtimes on the Listen page.

item.title: 0.2.5 — lyric metadata
item.description: Links every lyric-page artist credit to Ginger Deadman and sets every track type to Experimental.

item.title: 0.2.4 — changelog housekeeping
item.description: Simplifies the changelog explainer, opens the latest day by default, adds model credits and a planning-phase placeholder.

item.title: 0.2.3 — poem move
item.description: Moves the deadmanifesto poem and its reference line to the bottom of the Ginger Deadman page.

item.title: 0.2.2 — deadmanifesto hub link
item.description: Removes the Career link from the deadmanifesto hub.

item.title: 0.2.1 — Bio reframe
item.description: Renames EPK to Bio across the site and removes the press quote, photo, credit, contact and print block.

item.title: 0.1.43 — Bio biography
item.description: Replaces the biography with the Jack Wolfe alias, multimodal practice, open-archive description and professional-inquiry statement.

item.title: 0.1.42 — Unreal metadata
item.description: Removes The Unreal Tapes subtitle and sets Unreal to 2018, Experimental and the literal "x Tracks" count across the album page, Listen card, EPK and search index.

item.title: 0.1.40 — light-mode platform colours
item.description: Colours the Steam, Xbox, PlayStation and EA SVG icons for light mode and cache-busts the new artwork.
